changelog:
keyapi-youtube 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for analyzing YouTube videos and channels using the KeyAPI REST API and live official docs.
- Supports a wide range of YouTube data operations: video info, comments (with threads), streams, related videos, Shorts search, video/channel search, trending, channel metadata, channel videos, and ID/URL/handle resolution.
- Strict API workflow enforced: always consult live KeyAPI docs for method/path/parameters, do not use scraped or inferred API routes.
- Includes robust onboarding and authentication check with guidance for missing credentials and setup scripts.
- Integrates with helper scripts for API calls, docs resolution, and local credential management.
- Scenario-based question routing for both technical and non-technical users; workflow prioritizes minimal user input and strongest filtering.
summary: Analyze YouTube videos and channels through the KeyAPI REST API using live official docs. Use for video information, comments, sub-comments, streams, related videos, Shorts search, video search, trending videos, channel description, channel videos, channel ID/URL conversion, channel search, filtered
